tool.name: delete_file
tool.description: Delete a file or directory from the system

when_to_use.trigger: User explicitly asks to delete a file
User asks to remove or clean up files
User asks to free disk space by removing files

parameters.param: Path to file or directory to delete
Ignore nonexistent files and skip prompts

safety_rules.rule: NEVER delete /, /etc, /usr, /boot, /lib, /var, /home without EXPLICIT user confirmation
NEVER delete system directories or their contents
Always show full path and confirm before deleting
Warn about recursive deletion of non-empty directories
Suggest moving to trash instead of permanent deletion
Show what will be deleted before proceeding

tool.output_format: Returns: { "path": string, "deleted": boolean, "was_directory": boolean, "items_deleted": integer, "bytes_freed": integer, "message": string }
